collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: After two neighbors dispute a borrowed basket, a mediator asks whether faraway people quarrel over ordinary things.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After two neighbors dispute a borrowed basket, a mediator asks whether people in faraway lands quarrel over equally ordinary things.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villagers act out a distant argument over a missing tool; everyone recognizes the irritation.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The mediator notes that different customs may change what counts as borrowing or stealing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether disagreements between whole cities could begin with ordinary misunderstandings.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A fisher warns that conflicts over land and food may have causes too serious to reduce to hurt feelings.

text_only.reason: food talked about or imagined; the village's stores do not change

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Two estranged neighbors exchange a tentative greeting after hearing their own behavior described.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The original dispute remains unresolved; the mediator says understanding does not compel forgiveness.
